max_concurrency.description: A suggested upper bound on how many of this node's parallel branches (for example, the items of a For Each) a host should run at once. A host may clamp this lower to protect its own resources, run fewer branches at a time, or ignore it entirely and run unbounded; the workflow's result does not depend on how many branches were in flight at once.
